payload.artist_html: Z. M. Nochenski, T. Tomek, T. Szybiak & K. Wertz
payload.credit_html: "A new passerine (Aves: Passeriformes) and three other specimens of Late Oligocene birds from Poland, with a review of all Paleogene birds from the northern part of the Carpathian Arc"
payload.description_html: Comparison of coracoids in ventral view (top row) and humeri in caudal view (bottom row). From left to right: Jamninkaornis kencampbelli, holotype, specimen MSMD Av JAM2_1a+b from Jamna Dolna 2, SE Poland, Late Oligocene; interpretive drawing; specimens of suboscines from the ISEZ PAN collection: Tyrannidae: Empidonax minimus, Tyrannus tyrannus, Hemitriccus obsoletus; Tityridae: Schiffornis virescens; Pipridae: Ceratopipra mentalis, Manacus manacus. Scale bars are 5 mm.
